title: Victorian Streetwalk
summary: Saratoga’s holiday kickoff: a tree lighting, carolers and costumed performers along Broadway, with shops open late. Held the first Thursday of December in recent years.

title: Saratoga New Year’s Fest
summary: The city’s New Year’s celebration (formerly First Night) with indoor concerts, family events and fireworks. Indoor show tickets typically go on sale in late November.

title: Saratoga Chowderfest
summary: Dozens of restaurants serve chowder by the cup and you vote for the best. The biggest winter day of the year downtown — go early.

title: Saratoga Race Course: 2027 Summer Meet
summary: NYRA plans a return to the traditional 40-day meet in 2027, running through Labor Day. Official dates are usually announced early in the year.

title: The Travers Stakes
summary: The “Midsummer Derby,” first run in 1864 and the biggest day of the Saratoga season. Traditionally a late-August Saturday.
